name: Yong Ki Lee
headline: AI service developer at SK Telecom
intro: I turn complex data into actionable insights through LLM integrations and optimized data pipelines.
bio: Build full-stack services and analyze data to solve business problems, from concept to scalable production.
Choose technology for user value, operational efficiency, and practical impact.

bullets: Service planning, backend architecture, and development for Marketing AX Workspace.
Service planning, backend architecture, and development for Polaris Studio.
AI and backend engineering for SmartBee, a RAG chatbot service with an embeddable widget.
Backend engineering for customer conversation search (상담 검색 서비스).
Review topic classification and REVIEWRO backend development.
Data science for personalized targeting and network quality.
Backend development for personalized targeting and AIAS.
Vehicle sensor-data engineering and diagnostic trouble-code analysis.
Smart TV search services and electronic program guide data processing.
Servlet/JSP engine development and class-loading work for JEUS.

projects.title: Marketing AX Workspace
projects.summary: A conversational workspace for accessing business data and services through natural-language requests.

brief.problem: Help marketing teams use business data and tools through a conversational interface.
brief.role: Service planning, backend architecture, and backend development.
brief.challenge: Support varied user requests across existing data and service interfaces.
brief.approach: Planned the workspace experience and designed and implemented the backend for its service flows.

projects.title: Polaris Studio
projects.summary: A no-code AI workflow service for working with internal data and automating repetitive tasks.

brief.problem: Make customer data and AI workflows accessible to teams without requiring them to write code.
brief.role: Service planning, backend architecture, and backend development.
brief.challenge: Workflows need to accommodate different departmental data sources and services.
brief.approach: Planned the service workflows and designed and implemented the backend supporting them.

projects.title: SmartBee
projects.context: SK Telecom · RAG chatbot & embeddable widget
projects.summary: A RAG chatbot service with an embeddable widget that lets teams add document-based Q&A to existing websites.

brief.problem: Make document-based answers available inside the services people already use.
brief.role: AI and backend engineering for SmartBee.
brief.challenge: Support retrieval-based answers through an interface that is easy to install and use.
brief.approach: Connected the chatbot’s AI and backend capabilities to an embeddable widget experience.

projects.title: 상담 검색 서비스 (Customer conversation insights)
projects.context: SK Telecom · presented at SK AI Summit 2024
projects.summary: Backend engineering for SK Telecom’s AI-based customer conversation search service.

brief.problem: Find useful signals in unstructured customer conversations.
brief.role: Backend engineering for the customer conversation search service.
brief.challenge: Make conversations with different topics searchable for business questions.
brief.approach: Built the backend supporting AI-assisted conversation search and analysis.

projects.title: REVIEWRO
projects.summary: Backend development for REVIEWRO, a review-based fashion commerce app. The service closed in February 2023.

brief.problem: Help shoppers discover fashion products through reviews.
brief.role: Backend development and operation for the REVIEWRO app.
brief.challenge: Support review-based discovery alongside commerce workflows.
brief.approach: Built the backend connecting product and review data with the app’s commerce features.

projects.title: Review topic analytics
projects.summary: Review topic classification for e-commerce at 빌리뷰.

brief.problem: Help shoppers find relevant information in reviews that cover several topics.
brief.role: Led review-data pipelines, service APIs, and administration tools as co-founder and CTO.
brief.challenge: Handle informal review language and multiple topics within a single review.
brief.approach: Combined review collection and preprocessing with topic analysis and a storefront review widget.

projects.title: AIAS: network quality analytics
projects.summary: Backend development for AIAS, a map-based telecom network quality service.

brief.problem: Help network teams examine service quality in its location context.
brief.role: Data science and backend development for AIAS.
brief.challenge: Make network-quality and location data usable in a map-based service.
brief.approach: Built analytics data marts and backend APIs for exploring network quality.

projects.title: Personalized targeting
projects.summary: Data modeling and backend development for personalized targeting at SK Telecom.

brief.problem: Turn customer data into usable inputs for personalized marketing.
brief.role: Feature engineering, data modeling, and targeting backend development.
brief.challenge: Connect analytical customer profiles with operational marketing services.
brief.approach: Developed customer feature matrices and a targeting backend used for Biz-RCS.
